name: docs-governance
description: Mechanical documentation-consistency checks plus the two review subagents that handle only what a script cannot. Run the deterministic layers first; the model is the last resort, not the mechanism. v1.1 adds shadow-mode content rules (declared_counts, sum_decomposition, facts, version_citations) and sync_destinations (covers: frontmatter vs. real version:). v1.2 adds fragment_sync, dead_citations, and numbered_reference_consistency. v1.3 adds an optional `anchor` to fragment_sync, asserting that the heading a synced block restates still exists."
